tips.text: Keep the prebuilt Hound a vanquished Sister mails you instead of hand-building one; it works the same.
Check which Model each new Sister's Hound carries before committing to the fight.
Spawn Sisters on Hydra, where the Treasurer always drops a Zenith Crown, so one crown keeps the loop going.
Run the Granum Void solo; squads raise the kill requirement but you still get only one Candidate.
Clear the Granum Void fast with Xoris heavy attacks, a wide-nuke frame, or your Railjack On Call specter.
Plan on one component blueprint per Sister you vanquish; a squadmate's Sister often pays you nothing.
Check the Model before selling an unclaimed Hound for 20,000 credits; if it is Bhaira, claim it.
Keep the Golden Hand Tribute more than about 200 meters from extraction, or the Candidate may never spawn.
Expect two to four Sisters for a Bhaira Hound; most players skip hand-building and take what arrives.
Restart the mission if no Tribute has shown up halfway through the tile.
Mercy the Candidate only if you like her weapon; walking away guarantees the next Candidate a different one.
Do the Railjack confrontation in a squad for Corrupted Holokeys; each player can get up to four.
In a fast mission, slow down so all three Hounds spawn, and Mercy her Hound before downing her or it self-destructs.
Run Conservation and the debt-bond bounty solo on normal difficulty.
